messages:
maya: Quick idea Let's run a 35m webinar made of three tight "micro" demos (6m live + 2m transition each) + 9m Q&A. short, repeatable, easy handoff. good for segmented follow-ups?
tom: sounds good. shorter is better for sign-up -> attendance. can we let folks pick which demo they want in the form? makes follow-up cleaner.
serena: yes please. growth needs a demo-interest field in the form and HubSpot property for routing. will also add an intent question (pilot/POC/eval).
maya: speaker plan: tom = infra/dev platform, nick = semantic search demo, serena = customer summarization & cost slide.
nick: i'll prepare a deterministic test dataset + canned prompt file. please no flaky live internet calls.
dev-ops-bot: Reminder: staging demo environment snapshot scheduled 2025-06-10T15:00Z. ensure tokens rotated.
serena: fallback plan: each demo has a 60-90s recorded clip ready. ops needs a single keystroke to swap to video if latency > 250ms.
tom: i'll be the clock. 1-minute & 30-second warnings. also will add a one-liner on slide to 'switch to recorded clip' so ops can flip quickly.
maya: run-of-show draft: 00:00-00:04 host intro & agenda, 00:04-00:12 demo1, 00:12-00:20 demo2, 00:20-00:28 demo3, 00:28-00:37 Q&A + wrap. keep transitions tight.
nick: for repeatability, please seed demo db with `seed_dataset.sql` and point clients at `staging.redwood.local`. also we'll script a `curl` health check: `curl -s -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://staging.demo.redwood.local/health`
serena: we'll capture a 30s highlight clip from the rehearsal for socials. growth-bot: Action: reserve 30s clip slot for social content.
maya: task list: 1) speakers -> 250-300 word abstract + 3 bullet takeaways by Tue EOD. 2) growth -> landing page with per-demo checkbox + UTM tracking by Wed. 3) ops -> rehearsals + recording hot-swap tested. 4) salesops -> HubSpot schema + mapping sheet by Thu.
tom: slide guidance: 3 slides max per demo: problem, quick screenshot, one metric (latency/cost) + CTA. keep text minimal.
nick: will record nominal responses for each demo so we can fallback to a recorded live walkthrough if needed.
serena: rehearsal checklist: - confirm mic & camera - run the `curl` latency test - test recording swap - validate HubSpot webhook mapping - rehearse transitions
dev-ops-bot: Rehearsal scheduled: 2025-06-12 15:00 UTC. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood/rehearse-998. 5 confirmed.
maya: marketing copy plan: short X thread + 2-line email with 'choose your demo' CTA. growth to draft & share in this thread for review.
serena: post-webinar routing: push to HubSpot CSV with: email, demo_interest, company_size, intent, utm_source. salesops wants lead_score column too.
jack (sales): I'll accept demo_interest mapping. pls share exact property names.
maya: final Q what about live audience polls? keep 1 quick Slido poll mid-way to surface top Qs for the Q&A.
tom: agreed. slido + upvotes will help prioritize. moderator will filter top 6.
maya: ok closing notes: abstracts by Tue, landing page Wed, rehearsal Fri, final deck Mon. ping this thread when abstracts are in. :rocket:
